title: Kayode Lab welcomes new student researchers
body: We are pleased to welcome Samira, Javier, and Bailey to Kayode Lab at James Madison University. Their arrival marks an exciting step as we build our research team. We look forward to supporting their growth in molecular biology, diagnostics, and genomics through training, mentorship, and research.

title: Kayode Lab begins at James Madison University
body: Dr. Tolulope A. Kayode has launched the Kayode Lab in JMU’s Department of Biology. The lab brings together epidemiology, diagnostics, and genomics to study vector-borne disease transmission.
